urlValidation.title: URL Validation
urlValidation.validateDbUrlsDesc: When enabled, repository URLs found in the local database are verified (HTTP HEAD + git ls-remote) before being returned. Invalid URLs are deleted and resolution continues through the resolver chain.
urlValidation.validateSbomRefsDesc: When enabled, existing VCS URLs found in SBOM files are verified before enrichment. Invalid URLs trigger re-resolution of the component.
urlValidation.multipleVcs: Behavior when multiple valid VCS-links are found
urlValidation.multipleVcsDesc: When multiple VCS references are valid, choose whether to keep only the first one or keep all of them in the SBOM.
urlValidation.timeoutDesc: Timeout for each HTTP HEAD and git ls-remote check (1–60 seconds).
urlValidation.cooldownDesc: This setting controls how long a successfully validated URL remains in the validation cache before being re-checked. All validated URLs are treated equally regardless of origin (resolver, import, or database). Set to 0 to disable the cache and always re-validate.
urlValidation.infoText: URLs from resolvers are always validated before being returned. Validation results are cached and reused across all contexts (local database, SBOM enrichment) within the configured cooldown period.
urlValidation.clearCacheDesc: Remove all cached URL validation results. The next validation for each URL will perform a full check.

githubToken.title: GitHub API Token (optional)
githubToken.label: GitHub Personal Access Token
githubToken.desc: Used for authenticated git ls-remote and HTTP requests. Increases rate limits from 60/hr to 5000/hr for API, and removes limits for git operations.
githubToken.genTokenHint: → Settings → Developer settings → Personal access tokens → Fine-grained or classic

librariesio.title: Libraries.io Resolver (optional)
librariesio.enableDesc: When enabled, libraries.io is used as a fallback resolver when purl2repo cannot find a repository URL.
librariesio.apiKeyDesc: Optional API key for higher rate limits (60 req/min vs 10 req/min).
librariesio.loginHint: Log in to libraries.io → API Settings

ecosystems.title: ecosyste.ms Resolver (optional)
ecosystems.enableDesc: Live query to ecosyste.ms API for repository URL lookup. Works without API key. Key is optional for higher rate limits.
ecosystems.apiKeyDesc: Optional API key for higher rate limits.
ecosystems.maxRpsDesc: Rate limit for ecosyste.ms API requests (0.1–100 req/s). Default: 2.0. Lower values reduce timeout risk under concurrent load.

resolverBehaviour.title: Resolver Behaviour
resolverBehaviour.maxRetriesDesc: Maximum HTTP request attempts per resolver (including the first). Applied to ecosyste.ms and libraries.io on timeout, rate limit (429), and server errors (5xx). Default: 3. Range: 1–10.
resolverBehaviour.cooldownDesc: Base wait time between retries. Actual wait = cooldown × (attempt − 1). Example: cooldown=5 → waits 5s before 2nd attempt, 10s before 3rd. Range: 0.5–120 seconds.

jobManagement.title: Job Management
jobManagement.ttlDesc: Completed, cancelled, and failed jobs are automatically deleted after this many hours.

network.title: Network & Performance
network.batchLimitDesc: Maximum number of parallel PURL resolution requests in a batch (1–100). Default: 10.
network.probeUrlDesc: Target URL used to check internet access before URL validation. Set to empty to disable the probe.
network.probeTimeoutDesc: Timeout for the connectivity HEAD request (1–30 seconds). Default: 2.

logging.title: Logging
logging.logLevelDesc: Controls which log messages are shown in docker compose logs. DEBUG – all messages, INFO – general operations, WARNING – errors only.

jsonFormat.title: JSON Format
jsonFormat.indentSizeDesc: Number of spaces used when indenting JSON in downloaded files (SBOM, Images List).
